title: A normal gauge that keeps the boundary condition
reviewed_arguments: N1 constructs the ordered Picard series with all parameter derivatives, a right-equation inverse, norm bounds and uniqueness.
N2 expands both slots of the weak form and retains every ordered lower matrix; the interior normal derivative cancels while mx and ellx become kappa and minus kappa.
N3 proves positive H1/H2 traces, uses the complete earlier graph trace, and transports the complex flux to the actual Robin condition.
N4 retains every localization term and proves the Gaussian symbol and commutator rates with actual ordinary operator composition.
N5 supplies true H2 approximants in both domains, exact Robin correction and full regularized equation; convergence is strong H1 plus L2_x H^-1_z graph convergence.
N6 derives the exact Hermitian volume array and oriented boundary form with every imaginary matrix coefficient and normal operator derivative.
N7 gives the full matrix principal polynomial, exact negative Dirichlet square and retained complex Robin form.
N8 proves the identity on the actual H1 graph using complementary Sobolev pairings, convergence of the normal graph trace and the exact weak Dirichlet/Robin specializations.

Three complete exercises and a reproducible three-panel figure test ordered matrices, a single-mode Robin defect and independent direct integration of the normal identity. Five finite groups contain 58 exact cases.
Uniform estimates at higher microlocal order, incoming errors and full strict propagation remain unfinished. No automatic sign for the Robin form is claimed.
